text:
The follower output sits at 1.65 V and needs to drop about 0.4 V. The fix adds an R·I level shifter after the PMOS follower, bypassed by a capacitor so AC gain is kept. Noise is about 1.5× the prediction, and the sensitivity to Rf points to noise on the output side. The likely source is bias-node noise reaching Ms, so the pb bias node gets a bypass capacitor. Rf goes up a little, and the bias PMOS gm/Id goes up to give Mt and Ms more headroom.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Vout too high (follower at va+Vsg). Add a 2uA-sink plus resistor level shifter, bypassed by Cb so AC gain is kept. Bypass pb so bias noise does not reach Ms. Raise Rf to cut noise. Raise bias PMOS gm/Id for Mt/Ms headroom. Noise model now includes output-side sources."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "gmid_p": (15.0, 8.0, 16.0),
    "Lamp":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Ia":     (13e-6, 6e-6, 16e-6),
    "If":     (7e-6, 3e-6, 11e-6),
    "Rf":     (360e3, 280e3, 480e3),
    "Lf":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_f": (14.5, 8.0, 15.5),
    "Ish":    (2e-6, 1e-6, 3e-6),
    "vout_t": (1.15, 0.9, 1.35),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    gam = 0.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ip = 2e-6
    Lb, gmb, gmbn = 1.0, 16.0, 10.0
    Ia, If, Rf, Ish = p["Ia"], p["If"], p["Rf"], p["Ish"]
    Cb = 10e-12

    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Lamp"], Ia, vds=0.5)
    vin = mn.vgs
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Lamp"], Ia, vds=vin)
    vin = mn.vgs
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lamp"], Ia, vds=0.9)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lamp"], Ia, vds=mp.vgs)
    vt = vin + mp.vgs
    vds_tail = max(VDD - vt, 0.15)

    mf = lut.size("p", p["gmid_f"], p["Lf"], If, vds=1.3)
    vx = vin + mf.vgs
    mf = lut.size("p", p["gmid_f"], p["Lf"], If, vds=max(vx, 0.3))
    vx = vin + mf.vgs
    Rsh = max((vx - p["vout_t"]) / Ish, 10e3)
    vout = vx - Ish * Rsh

    mb = lut.size("n", gmbn, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmbn, Lb, iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mpd = lut.size("p", gmb, Lb, Ip, vds=0.9)
    mpd = lut.size("p", gmb, Lb, Ip, vds=mpd.vgs)
    vpb = VDD - mpd.vgs
    mn2 = lut.size("n", gmbn, Lb, Ip, vds=max(vpb, 0.2))
    mn3 = lut.size("n", gmbn, Lb, Ish, vds=max(vout, 0.2))
    mt = lut.size("p", gmb, Lb, Ia, vds=vds_tail)
    ms = lut.size("p", gmb, Lb, If, vds=max(VDD - vx, 0.12))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb",  "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.C("Cbn", "ibias", "vss", 10e-12)
    n.dev("Mn2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn2)
    n.dev("Mpd", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.C("Cpb", "pb", "vdd", 20e-12)
    n.dev("Mt",  "vt", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mt)
    n.C("Ct", "vt", "vss", 200e-12)
    n.dev("Mpi", "va", "iin", "vt", "vt", mp)
    n.dev("Mni", "va", "iin", "vss", "vss", mn)
    n.R("Rf", "va", "iin", Rf)
    n.dev("Ms",  "vx", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", ms)
    n.dev("Mf",  "vss", "va", "vx", "vx", mf)
    n.R("Rsh", "vx", "vout", Rsh)
    n.C("Csh", "vx", "vout", Cb)
    n.dev("Mn3", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn3)

    gm = mn.gm + mp.gm
    go = mn.gds + mp.gds
    Cf = mn.cgd + mp.cgd
    Ci = cpd + (mn.cgg - mn.cgd) + (mp.cgg - mp.cgd)
    cgs_f = max(mf.cgg - mf.cgd, 0.0)
    gxt = mf.gds + ms.gds
    Af0 = mf.gm / (mf.gm + gxt)
    Co = max(mn.cdd - mn.cgd, 0) + max(mp.cdd - mp.cgd, 0) + mf.cgd + cgs_f * (1 - Af0)
    Cx = ms.cdd + mf.cdd * 0.5
    Cout = cl + mn3.cdd
    g3 = mn3.gds

    def stages(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        M = np.array([[s * Ci + Yf, -Yf], [gm - Yf, go + s * Co + Yf]], dtype=complex)
        va = np.linalg.solve(M, np.array([1.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))[1]
        Yl = 1.0 / Rsh + s * Cb
        yf = mf.gm + s * cgs_f
        M2 = np.array([[yf + gxt + s * Cx + Yl, -Yl], [-Yl, Yl + g3 + s * Cout]], dtype=complex)
        sol = np.linalg.solve(M2, np.array([yf, 0.0], dtype=complex))
        # transimpedance of output-side noise currents: inject at vx (Ms, Mf) and at vout (Mn3)
        zx = np.linalg.solve(M2, np.array([1.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))[1]
        zo = np.linalg.solve(M2, np.array([0.0, 1.0], dtype=complex))[1]
        return va, sol[1], zx, zo

    def zt(f):
        va, h, _, _ = stages(f)
        return va * h

    z0 = abs(zt(1e3))
    f3 = 1e10
    for f in np.logspace(4, 10, 1200):
        if abs(zt(f)) < z0 / math.sqrt(2):
            f3 = f
            break

    fN = 1e6
    w = 2 * PI * fN
    en2 = 4 * kT * gam / gm
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * (abs(1.0 / Rf + 1j * w * (Ci + Cf)) ** 2)
    va1, h1, zx1, zo1 = stages(fN)
    ztn = abs(va1 * h1)
    vo2 = 4 * kT * gam * (ms.gm + mf.gm) * abs(zx1) ** 2 + 4 * kT * gam * mn3.gm * abs(zo1) ** 2
    in2 += vo2 / ztn ** 2
    power = VDD * (iref + Ip + Ia + If + Ish)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
    }
```
